item.text:
In my last post, I wrote about designing a reusable checklist. The checklist is now complete.

Designing it meant thinking through what belonged on the list. Finishing it meant turning those decisions into something I can refer to the next time I do the work.

That’s the part I wanted to make repeatable. When the work comes around again, I’ll have a place to start.
